topic: Frontier AI for 3D modeling, CAD, and manufacturing design (design for manufacturing, process planning, quoting, and production-ready geometry), plus intelligent systems that act in physical space, including robotics, with attention to AI-native startups when substantive evidence is available.
audience: Technical product managers and engineering leaders deciding where to build on frontier models for spatial, geometric, and manufacturing-design work. They understand LLMs and basic 3D and CAD concepts (parametric vs. mesh, simulation) but do not follow benchmarks or demos daily.
central_question: Which spatial, geometric, and manufacturing-design capabilities moved from demo toward dependable this month, and does the evidence behind each claim match what it claims? When relevant AI-native startups appear, what are they shipping?
